data: Your week-one essentials for joining Squad Atlas (Payments) at Meridian — on-call, compliance, releases, data, architecture, and ownership.
Which tool does Squad Atlas use to run its on-call paging rotation?
Atlas runs its on-call rotation through Opsgenie (Squad Atlas — On-Call Runbook). PagerDuty is Borealis, Splunk On-Call is Cypress, and the org-wide VictorOps policy was retired in 2024.
What is the acknowledgement SLA on an Atlas page before it escalates to the secondary?
Atlas pages have a 10-minute ack SLA; miss it and Opsgenie escalates to the secondary, then the squad lead (Squad Atlas — On-Call Runbook). Cypress holds 5 minutes and Borealis 15.
An alert fires for a failed payment settlement on Atlas. What severity is it?
Any settlement failure is money movement impacted, so it is always Sev1 — never downgrade to Sev2 because 'only a few payments' failed (Squad Atlas — On-Call Runbook).
Which compliance regime does Squad Atlas operate under?

Because Atlas handles cardholder data directly, it operates under PCI-DSS Level 1, the strictest tier (Squad Atlas — Compliance & Data Handling). Org-wide 'SOC 2 only' is a superseded 2023 baseline; SOX is Borealis and KYC/AML is Cypress.
How is card data classified under Atlas's data-classification scheme?

Card data is Tier 0 (Restricted), Meridian's highest tier — never logged, never in error messages, never leaving PCI scope (Squad Atlas — Compliance & Data Handling). Tier 1 is the lending/identity squads; 'Sensitive' is the retired two-tier scheme.
What is Atlas's production deploy-window policy?
Deploy any weekday; no fixed windows
No deploys on Friday or over the weekend

The Atlas pipeline is gated to refuse production releases Friday through Sunday because settlement runs continuously (Squad Atlas — Release & Change Policy). The 9–5 freeze is Cypress; 'deploy any weekday' is Borealis; 'self-merge anytime' is a superseded pre-2024 policy.
How many approvals does a production change to Atlas require before release?
No approval — self-merge once CI is green

Atlas requires dual approval — two engineers, one of whom has context on the area being changed (Squad Atlas — Release & Change Policy). Single approval is Borealis; self-merge is the retired pre-2024 model.
Which mandatory pre-merge check must pass before an Atlas pull request can merge?

The ledger-reconciliation contract test verifies recorded entries match settled balances; a red result blocks merge with no override (Squad Atlas — Release & Change Policy). The credit-model backtest is Borealis and the sanctions-screening test is Cypress.
What is the primary datastore behind atlas-ledger-svc?

Atlas's primary datastore is Aurora PostgreSQL, giving strong consistency and durability for money movement (Squad Atlas — Architecture & Datastores). DynamoDB is Borealis, Neo4j is Cypress, and shared MySQL was the decommissioned legacy monolith.
How does atlas-ledger-svc record a correction to the ledger?
It updates the existing ledger row in place
It deletes the row and re-inserts a corrected one
It appends a new entry that offsets the prior one
It edits the shared reporting table directly

The ledger is append-only: rows are never updated or deleted in place — corrections are new entries that offset prior ones, keeping a full reconstructable history (Squad Atlas — Architecture & Datastores).
What is the name of Squad Atlas's primary service — the codebase you'll spend most of your time in?

atlas-ledger-svc owns the ledger, settlement workers, and reconciliation logic (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership). payments-monolith was decommissioned in 2024; the others belong to Borealis and Cypress.
What is the internal codename for Atlas's payment-initiation API?

Rail is the internal name for the payment-initiation endpoint on atlas-ledger-svc — all payment initiation flows through it (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership). Bridge is Borealis, Gateway is Cypress, and PayGT was the legacy monolith's API.
Who is the squad lead and engineering manager of Squad Atlas?

Priya Nair leads Atlas and is the escalation point for ownership disputes and payment-path commitments; book a week-one 1:1 with her (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership). Dana Whitfield leads Cypress and Marco Reyes leads Borealis.
Where does Squad Atlas store its secrets?
A .env file checked into the repo
Vault, under a per-squad atlas/ namespace

All Atlas secrets live in Vault under the dedicated per-squad namespace atlas/; services read them at runtime and nothing is stored outside it (Squad Atlas — Secrets & Access). Borealis uses AWS Secrets Manager and cypress/ belongs to Cypress.
What customer-facing SLA does Atlas publish for payment status availability?

Atlas publishes a 99.95% monthly SLA — customers must be able to see a payment's state (pending, settled, failed) within that target every calendar month; a breach triggers a customer-facing comms review (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership).
